selection_reason: Full-W CTX4 PM4 is the reliable default with all36 core cases and public E203/C coverage of all12 frozen layers in six two-task boots. W2 is a separately validated two-full-task Pareto alternative with 7.7882% lower measured CPU cold cycles and smaller logical W capacity; physical timing, area and energy are unknown. Keeping the broader CPU-qualified default is not a claim that it is physically optimal.

negative_results_and_repairs: A red scheduling run rejected the copied micro schedule's X-read reuse count; CTX4 implements and measures the intended reuse.
A first full36 became stale after timestamp instrumentation changed; retained as failed and replaced by a fresh accepted complete suite.
Direct BEGIN-to-last-fire timestamps corrected the legacy frontend state counter's one-edge boundary difference.
W1 reduces logical W capacity but changed synthetic99 cold cycles only from211670 to211630; no significant throughput/energy/area victory inferred.
Independent gate red probes found aliased numeric evidence, CPU metadata/compile-profile mismatches, empty package proof and unlisted published code; fixes and distinct green evidence retained.

Earlier CPU Icarus negative batch was aborted after a normal simulation exceeded the intended later runtime cap; that incomplete failed batch is excluded. Actual Verilator false-success and missing-final-write controls are retained.
Historical D3 manifests captured tool versions only. Explicit post-run attestation retains this limit; final fresh selected regression captures actual tool hashes before and after.

CPU task marker excludes boot and the3 global M/N/count header reads; layer/shift/address descriptors and all X/W/bias follow the marker. This real measured prototype boundary is disclosed and is not formal contest timing.
A real W2 CPU red run rejected future OPEN before START; the authorized thin C variant moves START after tile0 COMMIT and retains one-Y-per-poll fair drain.

CPU evidence gate falsely accepted coherently relabelled nonzero/timeout tool commands; the repaired gate requires all ordinary commands exit0 and exact actual functional-failure exits for the two declared small negative controls. Fresh CPU-small passed the repaired gate.

mutation_testing.note: Counts are distinct classes per mechanism, not multiplied by PM/latency repetitions. Software metadata/gate probes and false-success C controls are counted separately.

fixed_numeric_contract: signed16 X/W; exact 64-product signed48 accumulation; signed49 bias add -> sat48 -> ties-to-even RNE shift0..47 -> sat32; separate raw-overflow/output-saturated flags.

window_conventions.real_cpu: last_shared_write_response_cycle - cold_marker_cycle + 1; includes task layer/shift/address descriptors, all X/W/bias loading and CPU/ICB stalls; excludes boot and three global M/N/task-count header reads, host SRAM image installation and audio preprocessing; prototype boundary, not official contest timing

guardrails: No physical area/power/energy/STA inference from generic cells, memory bits, CE or simulation clocks.
